xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe: Due to the overall fall in the electrode prices, the Company, in accordance with the applicable Ind AS has recognized inventory on Net Realizable Value (NRV) basis to the extent applicable and has accordingly written down the carrying cost of inventory. The value of such write down (Balance Sheet position) is Rs. 78 Crores as at 30th September, 2025, Rs. 75 Crores as at 30th June, 2025, Rs. 110 Crores as at 31st March, 2025 and Rs. 140 Crores as at 30th September, 2024.
